latest_release.name: GhostLock Pre-release
latest_release.body:
### GhostLock Pre-release

- **Version**: `v1.2` (`593`)
- **Commit**: [`5f6d604c`](https://github.com/YuKongA/ghostlock-app/commit/5f6d604c0ae66b28530af40bf9b540eeb311b141)

#### Commit Message
```
profiles: add 6.1.138-android14-11-g7b9e94e37cfa-mi (Xiaomi Pad 7 Pro) (#857)

Full-OTA derived profile for muyu (Xiaomi Pad 7 Pro) running HyperOS
OS3.0.302.0.WOYCNXM (Android 16).

- geometry from boot.img + xbl_config.img, extracted out of payload.bin
  with tools/extract_rs
- route: tcp_zerocopy (compact_waiter = 1), fallback none
- kernel_phys_load 0xa8000000, kernel_phys_offset 0x80000000 (the
  xbl_config memory map's NOMAP / DRAM base, not 0)
- verified on device: W1/W2 reach uid 0, ksud late-loads the KernelSU
  LKM for KMI android14-6.1, SELinux is restored to enforcing
- registers the profile in index.conf and both supported-device lists
```

#### Files
- `GhostLock-release.apk`: GhostLock Android Application
- `ghostlock`: Standalone GhostLock native binary (Android arm64-v8a)
- `GhostLock-kernel-profiles.zip`: Bundled kernel profiles (HOCON)
- `ghostlock-extract-android-arm64`: Kernel offset extractor CLI (Android arm64-v8a)
- `ghostlock-extract-linux-x86_64`: Kernel offset extractor CLI (Linux x86_64)
- `ghostlock-extract-macos-universal`: Kernel offset extractor CLI (macOS Universal arm64 + x86_64)
- `ghostlock-extract-windows-x86_64.exe`: Kernel offset extractor CLI (Windows x86_64)
